## Scope

This repository publishes only the independently validated public subset of Mindustry-UX.

- [ ] This PR concerns only the public changes described in the README: campaign wave countdown, sector **Resume / New Game**, and **Restore Previous Save**. Upstream-only changes belong in [Anuken/Mindustry](https://github.com/Anuken/Mindustry).
- [ ] I have read the README, including the build, backup, and issue-scope sections.
- [ ] I tested the change in-game where applicable, or explained why it cannot be tested.
- [ ] This PR contains no private development code, credentials, signing keys, player saves, or personal paths.
- [ ] I understand that the public branch is exported from a private development repository, and that large or experimental changes may be declined.
